details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- prompts/mode-plan.txt:148-160 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new 7-line "Scope-only blocker" rule takes the rendered prompt to 257 lines, which is over the DEFAULT limit of 250 in tests/prompt_size_budget.py (lines 13-17, 69-74).
  WHY: static-checks exits 1 with "FAIL: .../prompts/mode-plan.txt: 257 lines exceeds DEFAULT limit of 250" (check-run failed[3] on 862467b), so the lint aggregate stays red. The rule has to be shortened in both prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt and the rendered copy. Raising the tier is not allowed because EXPECTED_TIERS pins mode-plan.txt to DEFAULT. All reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:90-180 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: psbr_route routes the output whenever it has at least one parseable SCOPE_MISSING: line (the raw_paths loop, about lines 113-127). It never checks for a scope-only ^BLOCKED: line or for the absence of a PLAN_SELF_CHECK: BLOCKER line or another non-scope blocker.
  WHY: A mixed or non-scope planning block gets ai:scope-blocked and override_guard. After a grant, /reclarify re-plans, and planning blocks again on the real cause. This goes against Goal 4 ("Any other planning block ... behaves exactly as today"). Severities disagree: sonnet rated it NIT, while gemini, minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:190-254 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The psbr_answer_release trust filter (`if comment.get("author_association") not in TRUSTED_ASSOCIATIONS and user.get("type") != "Bot": continue`) accepts any Bot or OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR. scripts/unblock_ledger.py:595-600 trusts only the pipeline login. The filter also does not check reason=out-of-scope.
  WHY: Someone can post a forged unsigned `<!-- ai:guard-rejection:v1 ... guard=scope ... -->` marker with the planning header. A human /answer then returns release=true and removes ai:scope-blocked, which can clear an implement-time latch that the ledger and override_guard would have refused. All three rated it MAJOR. Sonnet raised the same issue as a hardening suggestion only.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2389-2475 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The ai:scope-blocked label edit (lines 2400-2404, `|| true`) and the marker comment post (lines 2462-2475) are separate operations with no rollback.
  WHY: If the edit fails, header and marker are posted without the label (stop=blocked, no override_guard). If the comment post fails, the label stays with no marker: latest_rejection returns "missing", answer-release returns release=false reason=no_rejection, and the latch survives /answer. Severities disagree: sonnet and glm rated it NIT, while gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:830-833 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The override_guard branch of plan() (~line 1107-1110) calls reset_ops. reset_ops keys on ctx["has_plan"], which scripts/unblock_judge.sh lines 1815-1819 set from any earlier "Implementation Plan" comment. A planning-time scope block that has a stale plan in its history therefore resumes with /approved instead of /reclarify.
  WHY: Implement starts from the superseded plan, the newly granted files go unused, and the re-plan never runs. Severities disagree: sonnet and minimax rated it MAJOR, glm rated it NIT and called it a residual edge that the issue's wording accepts. The highest is used.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:127-140 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `if len(paths) > MAX_OVERRIDE_PATHS` is checked after deduplication, so more than 20 raw SCOPE_MISSING: lines that include duplicates are still routed.
  WHY: The linked issue says a list "longer than 20 entries" must behave as today. The fix is to also reject when len(raw_paths) > MAX_OVERRIDE_PATHS. Sonnet and glm raised the same point as hardening suggestions.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2395-2398 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"` makes a `gh label create` call on every routed block, because scripts/label_helpers.sh lines 187-200 cache per label and do no read.
  WHY: This adds one GitHub write per routed block. That contradicts the issue's §15 "no new GitHub API calls", the README "Adds no API call." and the changelog "New GitHub API calls: 0". glm says the code follows the plan and the documented zero-call claim is what is wrong.
- tests/test_plan_scope_block_route.py:113 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `assert f"outcome=not_routed issue=77" in result.stdout` is an f-string with no placeholders (ruff F541).
  WHY: The pre-push affected-tests gate (ruff check --select E,F on changed Python files) fails until the `f` prefix is removed. Minimax raised it as a hardening suggestion and gemini as a task gap.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10425-10442 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In add_files_touched_companions, `if walked != entries or first_idx < 0: sys.exit(3)` exits without writing a reason= line to stderr.
  WHY: apply_judge_files_touched_companions then logs reason=helper_failed, which looks the same as a missing-module or import failure. Sonnet and glm raised the same point as hardening suggestions.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10460-10518 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: apply_judge_files_touched_companions logs directly to stdout.
  WHY: The single-line log convention is brittle, and future debug logs could silently break grep-based log scrapers.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1048-1063 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `bash scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh answer-release` runs on the /answer path without checking PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED. The README row says only "`false` turns routing off."
  WHY: An operator who sets the flag to false still gets ai:scope-blocked removed on /answer for markers posted before the flip, which contradicts the README.
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:687 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `assert ci.count("CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}") == 6` fails with "assert 1 == 6" in tests-system-python, tests-sandbox-python and orchestrate-poll.
  WHY: The PR's only ci.yml hunk does not touch that line, so the failure is likely inherited, but it keeps lint red and must be confirmed before merge. glm's missing-context note says it does not reproduce on the PR head (6 occurrences present).
- (unmapped — tests-release-and-log-analysis job):n/a | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: One test in tests-release-and-log-analysis fails (check-run failed[5] on head SHA 862467b466c0871449ea3e51a897221243fc8b3f). The log tail is truncated at tests/test_release_validate_ci_gate.py "OK: 6", so the failing test is not identified.
  WHY: The lint aggregate (failed[0]) lists this job as unsuccessful, so the PR cannot go green until the test is identified and fixed or confirmed inherited. Sonnet also noted failed[5] as unmappable. glm rated it MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Static-checks gate (tests/prompt_size_budget.py) must pass; prompts must stay within the 250-line maximum.
  expected_change_site: prompts/mode-plan.txt (and prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: prompts/mode-plan.txt has 257 lines, which exceeds the 250-line limit enforced by static-checks. No diff hunk shortens the rule, and the CI log shows static-checks failing on this exact file.
- requirement: "Both behaviours can be switched off with a repo variable, and both are on by default." / "README.md: add rows for both variables to the env-var tables … and a sentence to the plan-blocked description."
  expected_change_site: README.md env-var table row for PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED (near line 311)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The README env-var table does not say that answer-release is not gated by PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED. That fact appears only in scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:28-31 and agents.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md. Gemini also named scripts-pending-removal.md as a change site.
- requirement: "no new GitHub API calls" (linked issue, Constraints #3)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked" is called for each routed planning block, which adds a new API call.
- requirement: Ensure lint compliance in test files (ruff F541).
  expected_change_site: tests/test_plan_scope_block_route.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The f-string at line 68 (assert f"outcome=not_routed issue=77" in result.stdout) has no placeholders and fails ruff lint.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- prompts/mode-plan.txt (and its source, prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt):lines 151-157 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rendered prompt was already at the DEFAULT 250-line cap (tests/prompt_size_budget.py lines 13-17, 69-74), and the 7-line rule takes it to 257.
  WHY: static-checks fails with "FAIL: .../prompts/mode-plan.txt: 257 lines exceeds DEFAULT limit of 250" (failed[3] on 862467b). The fix needs zero net growth in the template, followed by a regenerated rendered copy. Raising the tier is not the fix because EXPECTED_TIERS pins DEFAULT.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:plan() override_guard branch; reset_ops lines 831-833; scripts/unblock_judge.sh lines 1815-1819 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: has_plan is true whenever any older trusted "Implementation Plan" comment exists, so a planning-time scope block with a pre-re-plan plan posts /approved instead of /reclarify.
  WHY: Implement starts from the superseded plan. Fix: when "ai:blocked" is in labels and stop == "scope-blocked", take the /reclarify branch.
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:psbr_route raw_paths loop (around lines 113-125) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Routing never checks for the scope-only form. blocked=true can also come from PLAN_SELF_CHECK: BLOCKER, or from a BLOCKED: line with a non-scope reason (plan.yml lines 2185-2207, 2289-2310).
  WHY: Mixed blocks get ai:scope-blocked, and each grant then spends a judge round. This goes against Goal 4. Fix: return not_routed unless the output has ^BLOCKED: and no PLAN_SELF_CHECK: BLOCKER: (~4 lines).
- tests/test_plan_scope_block_route.py:test_refused_scope_lines_are_not_routed | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `assert f"outcome=not_routed issue=77" in result.stdout` has no placeholders (ruff F541).
  WHY: The pre-push gate lists ruff among the failures this change causes. Fix: drop the `f`.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:Lines 2400-2404 and 2474-2475 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The label
